fields.description: The course whose practical competency is being evaluated. Normally one that requires a supervisor sign-off — the evaluation is how that sign-off gets booked rather than happening whenever.
fields.label: Course

fields.description: The learner being evaluated. Named `user` on the sign-off it feeds; here it is the person whose competency is booked to be watched.
fields.label: Learner

fields.description: Who runs the evaluation. An Employee, because the sign-off it produces is a statement made in a role (matching Training Signoff.supervisor).
fields.label: Evaluator

fields.description: Derived from the evaluator's Employee record, not typed. This is who record_evaluation checks the caller against.
fields.label: Evaluator User

fields.description: Scheduled while it is booked; set by recording an outcome (Completed) or by hand (Canceled / No Show). The learner sees only Scheduled evaluations.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: When the evaluation is booked for (local time).
fields.label: Scheduled On

fields.description: Where it happens — a site, a room, or a meeting link.
fields.label: Location

fields.description: The Training Signoff this evaluation produced. Set by record_evaluation when the outcome is recorded — the evaluation books the observation; the sign-off is the attestation.
fields.label: Sign-off

fields.description: Scheduling notes — what to bring, what will be assessed. The competency verdict itself is recorded on the sign-off, not here.
fields.label: Notes
